literature_match: The tested terminal block separates short kinase-deficient and long kinase-containing TrkB transcript paths, including the TrkB.T1 family.
characterized_function: Astrocytes predominantly express TrkB.T1, and astrocyte-specific or global loss reduces morphological maturation and impairs support of excitatory synaptogenesis.

literature_match: The two tested paths differ by the 111-nt C1 cassette while sharing the adjacent C-terminal exon.
characterized_function: The C1 cassette contains endoplasmic-reticulum retention motifs and changes surface trafficking of full-length GluN1 receptors.

literature_match: The tested six-path N-terminal block contains the established PSD-95 alpha/beta alternative starts, but the omnibus result does not isolate that pair.
characterized_function: The beta-specific L27 domain binds CASK and Hrs; Hrs disruption selectively blocks PSD-95 beta synaptic clustering while sparing palmitoylated PSD-95 alpha.
functional_context: rat hippocampal neurons and heterologous cells

literature_match: The two tested paths differ by the 54-nt mouse App exon 15, whose exclusion produces the L-APP family.
characterized_function: Exon-15 exclusion changes polarized secretion of APP and decreases beta-amyloid production relative to p3; APP exon-15 isoform groups also have cell-specific neuronal and non-neuronal distributions.
functional_context: transfected epithelial cells, with endogenous distribution established in rat tissues

literature_match: The tested 63-nt cassette is Enah exon 11a.
characterized_function: Mena11a reduces actin polymerization, membrane protrusion, and cell motility; its depletion perturbs epithelial cell-cell junctions. The characterized function is outside the brain.

literature_match: The two 115-nt fitted alternatives are the GluA2 flip and flop exon pair.
characterized_function: Flip-containing GluA2 channels desensitize more slowly and retain a larger steady-state current than flop-containing channels; the distinction persists in tested heteromers.
functional_context: recombinant GluA2 channels in Xenopus oocytes

literature_match: The two 92-nt fitted alternatives are the developmentally regulated Nav1.2 5N and 5A exons encoding part of the domain-I voltage sensor.
characterized_function: The neonatal 5N channel activates at more depolarized voltages than adult 5A, and splice context changes the effects of several early-onset epileptic-encephalopathy variants.
functional_context: heterologous channel electrophysiology and neuronal modeling

literature_match: The tested 93-nt cassette is the conserved RRM exon; skipping deletes 31 amino acids from the RNA recognition motif.
characterized_function: The full isoform is stable and splicing competent, whereas the exon-skipped isoform is defective; Rbfox3-dependent Numb splicing promotes postmitotic neuronal differentiation.
functional_context: developing chicken spinal cord and transfected cells

literature_match: The tested 21-nt microexon encodes the conserved acidic beta domain.
characterized_function: Beta inclusion increases MEF2D transcriptional activation in reporter assays; beta-containing transcripts are enriched in brain and striated muscle.
functional_context: mammalian expression and transcriptional reporter assays
